newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse ends higher, big volume in SSB.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse ends higher, big volume in SSB.

text.p: The Ghana stock exchange edged higher on Friday in a session enlivened by another big block trade in Social Security Bank (SSB).
The Ghana All-Shares Index added 3.12 points to 393.59.
Volume was an unusually large 1,862,540 shares, but SSB accounted for 1,778,000 of that.
Dealers said this could be a further sale from the government's holding, although the parties to the transaction do not have to be revealed until next week.
The share price rose 40 cedis to 1,430.
Other gainers included Commercial Bank, which added 10 to 570, and Unilever, up five at 965.
The only decliner was Mobil Oil, which lost 100 to 6,000.
